metadata.scenario_context: Multiple tech companies from around the globe have come together for a substantial project and have scheduled a meeting in July to measure the work progress

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Great Britain agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the July 9
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Peter

Hey Mark, I was thinking... what do you think about holding the meeting on July 9? It seems like a good date for everyone involved, right? 

Also... just out of curiosity, what’s your view on the idea of having army rule? I know it can be a touchy subject, but I think it has its merits.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:
July 9 sounds reasonable. We should check if everyone can make it. I mean, it’s important we get everyone on board.

As for army rule... I really think it’s problematic. In Great Britain, we value democracy and believe that having the army in charge is just wrong. I can't see any merit in that idea at all.

shared_prefix.message: I understand your concern, but in some places, army rule can actually bring stability and order. It's not always negative. But back to the meeting... let’s make sure we get confirmations from everyone for July 9. It’s critical we stay on track with this project.
